dedupe_keys.name: malin anr 2019 firefighter indoor and outdoor localisation sensors

description: The CyborgLOC team provides multi-sensor traces from two firefighter localisation scenarios at the CFIS training centre in Blois, France, during the MALIN-ANR 2019 competition. GNSS, inertial sensors and a stereo camera accompany participants through indoor and outdoor spaces, urban canyons and stairs from a basement to the sixth floor. Each route covers about two kilometres and combines pedestrian movements with vehicle travel. Zenodo distributes ROS bag data in two ZIP archives free under CC BY 4.0, with surveyed reference points and enclosing volumes for evaluating localisation. Coverage is a controlled competition, not actual emergency-response operations, and stationary reference points do not establish continuous trajectory truth. A reviewer-assessed use is checking positioning errors and movement assumptions in emergency-service or building simulations. platform-ns-3 supplies a related communications simulation environment, but sensor ingestion would require adaptation. Linked Python processing tools are separately documented. No sensor archive, image stream or evaluation program was downloaded.
